text_block_list.text:
Before a race, I find Эйр Грув
quivering in the
waiting room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You fool. Quite the contrary. I am
absolutely
elated.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
After all, today I move one step closer
to
becoming a model for Umamusume
everywhere.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
That goes without saying. Keep your
eyes on the
Empress and witness my
victory!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
